program.section_heading: Certificate of Completion in Wildland Fire Technology Noncredit
outcomes: Demonstrate the basic knowledge, skills and abilities to safely perform the tasks required by the United States Forest Service, Bureau of Land Management, and the National Park Service as an entry level wildland firefighter.
Explain good nutritional habits and demonstrate the physical ability to successfully pass the Work Capacity Test required by the United Sates Forest Service to become a wildland firefighter.

notes: The catalog prints no explicit heading for the noncredit section; the section heading is taken from its opening sentence ('The Certificate of Completion in Wildland Fire Technology Noncredit').
The catalog prints units (0) rather than hours for this noncredit certificate, with 'MINIMUM CERTIFICATE UNITS 0'; measure recorded as units and total_units as 0. No hours are stated in the text.
